Only what the chosen module ref cannot supply, or what we deliberately
differ on. This branch pins libp2p_module and openmetrics-module at the
revisions the harness would have chosen anyway, so both are derived.
logos-logoscore-cli is the one standing disagreement: the branch locks
454e0696, the harness has always run 665ac28b. Drop this entry to follow
